Name: Here Be Dragons - Dinosaur Replacer for CP and AT
Author: nordkyst
Description:
A very simple mod to turn dinosaurs into dragons, for folks like me who love a fantasy-themed playthrough!
You can install either or both the CP and AT versions. I recommend both so you can have all the colors!
Making 16x16 sprites into recognizable dragons was surprisingly hard, so I hope you guys like the result :)
[b]
[u][size=3]Content Patcher Version Features:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Config option to choose the dragons' color[/b]
Color options: Black (default),  Blue, Gold, Green, Pink, Purple, Red, false (reverts to default dino)[/list][list]
[*][b]Config option to increase sale [/b][b]prices of Eggs & Mayo
[/b]Egg price options: Vanilla (350, default), 500, 700
Mayo price options: Vanilla (800, default), 1000, 1200
[size=2][i](These are intended to make it more profitable to raise dragons, despite their long incubation time.
Prices listed are base and will be affected by quality, skills, etc.)[/i][/size][/list][list]
[*][b]Updated item names, icons, & descriptions:
[/b]Dinosaur Egg -> Dragon Egg
Dinosaur Mayonnaise -> Wyrmblessed Potion
[/list][u]
[b][size=3]Alternative Textures Version Features:[/size][/b][/u][list]
[*][b]Just textures. [/b][b]No item/dialogue changes.[/b] Apply them with the Scissors, simple as. 
Installing this alongside the CP version allows you to have multiple colors of dragons at once.[/list][b][size=3][u]
For other modders:[/u][/size][/b]
Making recolors is OK, but please credit and link back!
I'd love to edit text/dialogue references to show dragons instead of dinos but I'm not super sure how to do it :'')
If you have ideas, I'd love to learn from you or collaborate with you to add to this mod, with credit to you!
You can best reach me on discord @ stonebutchblues. (Please do not submit bug reports via Discord.)
